column1: % Italian verb lexicon for enclitic splitting and clitic deprel assignment.
% Extracted from the gold annotation of UD_Italian-ISDT (train+dev) and
% UD_Italian-PoSTWITA (train): every lemma of a VERB/AUX token, with the
% argument frames actually observed for it.
%   Obj   the lemma governs an obj  in the gold data
%   Iobj  the lemma governs an iobj in the gold data
%   Refl  the lemma governs an expl* (reflexive, impersonal or passive si)
%   Freq  occurrences as VERB/AUX, as a rough confidence weight
% The three frames are recorded separately on purpose. A single valency label
% would have to be arbitrary for most verbs, since Italian verbs freely combine
% frames (dare qc a qn, darsi, darne): 'yes' here means attested, never
% exclusive. Rules should therefore test the frame they need rather than a
% summary label, and treat a lemma with several 'yes' values as undecided.
